title: Star Wars Blips
overview: What does a curious little droid do when he's not hurtling through space on a daring mission to save the galaxy? Star Wars Blips stars BB-8 in his very own series of animated shorts, featuring heroes of the Star Wars universe like Chewbacca, C-3PO and of course, R2-D2.

title: Star Wars: Galaxy of Creatures
overview: Join adventurous droid SF-R3, “Aree,” a member of the Galactic Society of Creature Enthusiasts, as he journeys across the galaxy to learn everything there is to know about wildlife.

title: Star Wars Galactic Pals
overview: Miree will look after a variety of galactic younglings: Ewoks, Wookiees, Ortolans, Huttlets, Jawas, Rodians, Gamorreans, Gungans, as well as tauntauns, rancors, porgs, and Loth-cats.
